 6 BGB platoons deployed in Gopalganj to maintain law and order
 Troops to coordinate with other law enforcement agencies and follow the district magistrate’s instructions 
 Published : 15 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 15 November 2026, 13:56
 • 
 CRIME & JUSTICE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 Six platoons of Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) have been deployed in Gopalganj to maintain law and order and ensure public security.
 In a press release issued today, the BGB Media Wing said its personnel would carry out their assigned duties in coordination with other law enforcement agencies, in accordance with the requirements and instructions of the district magistrate.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 The deployment comes amid recent incidents of clashes and vandalism carried out allegedly by activists of the Awami League, whose activities are banned, and its affiliated organisations in Gopalganj.
